Actor-owned persisted query snapshot: initial query freezes all matching rows, total and cross-page summary in one repeatable-read transaction. Subsequent pages require the same normalized query and querySnapshot; cursor is an offset only within that snapshot. Read permission is checked on every request. Snapshot expires after 30 minutes; expiry/query mismatch is 409, another actor is 404. from/to/timezone must be supplied together and mean activity window overlap [from,to); undated drafts do not match. query matches internal name or activity/event ID; name matches internal name. Published activity metadata stays at activeVersion while current may be a candidate draft. Sorting is stable with activityId as tie-breaker.

get.description: A new query freezes totals, reward facts and SKU/template/beneficiary aggregations in the existing report snapshot. Reuse querySnapshot with identical activity/version/window/timezone and an offset cursor to page; groupBy can switch within the snapshot. Actor ownership and current metrics-read permission are checked each time; changed query or expired snapshot rejects with 409.

patch.description: Existing compatibility alias of POST; identical idempotency scope.

post.description: Explicit submit-capability command PENDING_APPROVAL/APPROVED -> DRAFT on the current candidate version. Checks version expectedRevision, reason and retained idempotency; clears approval facts without changing the active published version or root lifecycle. Separate from checker reject. Published/ended/archived versions cannot withdraw. Saved approved content requires withdrawal first.

Amount.description: Decimal string; max existing D4 precision 18,6. Asset catalog controls allowed scale; excess precision rejected, never rounded.

Time.description: UTC RFC3339 instant with trailing Z.

resolvedDeviceRights.description: Required non-null for approved DEVICE_RIGHTS policies. Server-resolved immutable materialization, not accepted in PolicyDraft input.

anyOf.description: Internal administrative activity name, independent of the localized public title; versioned with the draft and never used as identity.

Draft.description: Persistable draft. Only category/template are mandatory. Missing or null configuration has no business default and cannot authorize publication.

SingleOrderInput.description: Existing optional fields remain optional. orderNo must be omitted or null. promotionQuoteId must match account, SKU, quantity and voucher in persisted quote.

BundleOrderInput.description: itemCount counts lines; quantity counts units. Duplicate SKU lines rejected; <=100 total units.

amountUsdt.description: Promoted orders always return the frozen exact six-decimal string through the shared projection; legacy orders retain their existing numeric serializer.

items.description: Frozen purchased items for promoted orders. Historical receipts are enriched from their original canonical order items, never the current catalog.

OrderReceipt.description: Legacy responses may omit additive properties. Promoted orders require all properties; enforced by runtime response contract and fixtures.

RefundInput.description: Existing E4 whole-order command. Authenticated actor overrides operator. No client amount.

dispositionOptions.description: Server-resolved confirmed refunds and valid current approved A2 corrections for this obligation; executable authorization is rechecked transactionally on command.

ResolveInput.description: Requires matching asset evidence; no arbitrary terminal-state edit.

salesBySku.description: All purchased SKUs in the paid-order cohort, with exact frozen post-discount allocation and confirmed whole-order refunds as of the same snapshot. A bundle counts once for each purchased SKU; per-SKU order counts must not be summed as total orders. Independent of reward groupBy/pagination.

Metrics.description: orders uses distinct order.created_at in [from,to); paidOrders/gross use paid_at in the same window; refunds/refundedOrders refer to that paid cohort as of asOf and require a confirmed wallet refund receipt. Therefore cross-cohort conversionRate is unavailable. Snapshots retain created and paid order manifests. Fixture/sandbox facts are excluded.

AudiencePreview.description: Read-only census of nondeleted, nonsandbox accounts. Validates only audience structure and required audience/first-purchase policies; draft may omit time/rewards/budget/global settlement policies. Unknown dependencies never count as rejected or as device absence. Counts sum to total when the account source is available. estimatedAccounts is null if unknowns exist. Samples are at most 20 account IDs with no contact data, and are returned only with the existing user_c1_read capability; otherwise samples is empty and aggregate counts remain available.

sampleAccountId.description: A nonnull account requires the existing user_c1_read capability in addition to growth_promotion_simulate; otherwise return 403 PROMOTION_ACCOUNT_SAMPLE_FORBIDDEN. Null permits a configuration preview with explicitly unknown account eligibility.

giftEligible.description: Whether the current gift executor can fulfill this SKU's complete native rights. Independent of paid purchase availability.

nativeContracts.description: Server-resolved reference allowlist for policy creation. No native business configuration is returned; unresolved or unsupported contracts are disabled with an explanation.

RewardAdminPage.description: total and rows are read from one REPEATABLE_READ transaction for the complete query before cursor. Each next-page read is fresh and returns its own asOf; unlike the activity list, it is not a persisted cross-page snapshot.

LegacyRefundOrder.description: Unchanged existing DeviceOrderView; native BigDecimal/LocalDateTime wire format retained. New promotion money schemas always use decimal strings.

DispositionBasis.description: Server resolves a confirmed whole-order refund or a current approved A2 operation bound to this obligation and action. A string reference alone does not authorize cancellation/reversal.

name.description: Internal administrative activity name, independent of the localized public title; versioned with the draft and never used as identity.

PromotionContract.description: Complete stored contract validated on submit, approve and publish. Satisfying this shape is insufficient without resolving current approved policies and executable capabilities.

anyOf.description: Internal administrative activity name, independent of the localized public title; versioned with the draft and never used as identity.

DraftPatch.description: Top-level patch: omitted fields stay unchanged; supplied objects/arrays replace that entire field; null clears an unfinished value. An unpublished draft may change category/template after the interface explains incompatible fields and the confirmed patch explicitly clears or replaces them; reject unresolved incompatibilities without changing the draft. Audit before/after values and preserve published snapshots, used rule identities and historical counts. Candidate metadata does not change the effective activity projection until publication. activityId/version/revision and approval fields are forbidden here.

ResolvedApprovedPolicy.description: Server-resolved stored policy after actual authority/executor checks; this schema is never a client-supplied approval.

PromotionImpact.description: Operational facts across all versions, including marked fixtures. reserved counts future reward obligations, unpaidOrders counts distinct reserved orders. issued requires a matching wallet/device receipt and remains a gross historical count after reversal. pendingRewards includes PENDING/READY/PROCESSING; unresolved includes RETRYABLE_FAILED/OUTCOME_UNKNOWN/REVERSAL_PENDING/MANUAL_REVIEW; unfulfilledRewards includes all nonterminal obligations. Amounts stay split by asset and device SKU. No inferred revenue.

AggregateAmount.description: Read-only sums may exceed a single DECIMAL(18,6) entry. Single-entry Amount and database constraints remain unchanged.

AdminSimulation.description: Admin-only draft diagnostics, never a checkout quote or reservation. Reward units are shared evaluator outputs grouped by purchase units and beneficiary. Resource demand remains separate from actual eligibility; shortages are explicit blockers, unknown demand is null. No actual cost source means no inferred cost. Publish still revalidates all current facts.

MetricRewardGroupRow.description: One reward grouping and asset; device gifts split by gift SKU. SKU is the purchased SKU from the immutable award snapshot. TEMPLATE is the original contract template. BENEFICIARY splits by original beneficiary role and account ID. Amounts use original asset units; none represent acquisition cost.

MetricRewardBreakdown.description: Server aggregate of obligations created in the report window, with receipt/reversal outcomes through the same asOf. Rows, total and all top metrics remain fixed under querySnapshot; deterministic ordering and offset cursor. Switching groupBy retains the snapshot and top-level totals. Export includes all groups and the enriched immutable reward facts.

deviceName.description: DEVICE model name from the original approved E1 product contract evidence. Null for USDT/NEX; never resolved from the current store catalog.

RewardDisclosure.description: Public benefit and refund terms resolved exclusively from the published or frozen original policy snapshot. No native hashes, approval identities or internal configuration. Device rights are null for asset rewards. Historical orders never consult current promotion terms.

productName.description: Original canonical purchased order item name.

OrderReceiptItem.description: Purchased canonical order line. lineId is the actual order item ID and joins ExpectedReward.lineId; never a quote line ID.
